sonnet.problem: The oven joke repeats the shape of the one in Stop 1 card 9. Both set Paul's endurance against Papa Dorin being unable to cope with his oven ("I need a breather when my oven timer beeps" / "I can't go ten minutes without checking my oven").
sonnet.rule: Each joke idea, comparison and punchline shape is used once per lesson.

sonnet.problem: The card sets up a contrast between Isaiah's "ever hearing but never understanding" people and the Gentiles who "will listen". Acts 28:28 never says Paul is answering Isaiah's words with this line. The card states a connection the text leaves open.
sonnet.rule: Leave open what the text leaves open. Who is being spoken to, why, or how two things connect.
